hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(\.env([^A-Za-z0-9._-]|$)|Sources/Paid)' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '\b(rm|del|erase|mv|move|Remove-Item|ri)\b'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked: command touches a protected path (.env or Sources/Paid) combined with a destructive/move operation. Ask the user first."}}'; fi
